notes.title: North Stars 2.28 Release
notes.notes:
1.Fix the bug about the lack of character of multiplayer games.
2.Weaken Theta : Floating in the sky cost more energy.
3.Weaken Epsilon : The damage of Light Cone decreased.
Unfixed BUGs:
1.Players can join the game halfway.
Current mitigation methods: If you have choose a character in your own game , you can have a character in the game you join halfway
2.Transnational Games And Network Delay
Current mitigation methods: Before the game, check everyone's regions. Avoid international online games

notes.title: North Stars 2.27 Update!!!
notes.notes:
Key Updates:
1. [u][b]Add single player game[/b] [/u], including one story and two small games.
2. [u][b]Add lauguage option [/b][/u], now you can select Simplified Chinese or English.
3. Add words explaintion to game tutorial and something else.
4. Fix the item in the map "LightMemory".
5. Change the art of Room(Space), game settings now better than before.
6. Now the skill explaintion will automatically appear when you have choosen the character.
(that means you needn't press T)

Tip: There is still no place to tune the sound. The person who needs to tune can use the sound manager in the lower right corner of the computer.
Tip: The story has not yet been dubbed because the music maker has not yet appeared (QAQ).

Other Updates:
7. Rewrite the network system (next release starts optimization) .
8. Make the HP/EN/EX bar short and move them to the right bottom corner.
9. Fix the bug of the launcher's model.
10. Add the words of producers.
11. Add shadow for player.
